summary: Two formal update comparisons have admissible counterexamples; full-rank limiting inference is invalid; separate released vision-code boundary denominators are wrong.

problems.title: Theorem 3.2(4) reverses the FKLD/RKLD ordering
problems.claim: Delta_R > Delta_F under the listed probability-gap and ratio conditions.
problems.location: PDF p21 Theorem 3.2(4); p22 equations30-35; dependencies pp4,23
problems.check: p=(.01,.01,.98), q=(.4,1e-6,.599999), eta=1,c0=2,c1=.5,zeta=.1,delta2=.2. All inequalities verified. Direct softmax gradients give DeltaF=-.399999, DeltaR=-1.0030948483303108.
problems.counterevidence: Proof chooses sufficiently large p0, an additional condition. Correcting the printed KL direction does not fix this counterexample. Other theorem cases are not disproved.
problems.impact: Invalid core theoretical comparison of confidence concentration; empirical score effects unmeasured.
problems.correction: Exact conditional identity DeltaR-DeltaF=eta*(q1-q2)*(log(p0/I)+KL(q||p)); p0>I suffices. This restricts the claim.

problems.title: Theorem F.3(3) has false alpha monotonicity
problems.claim: Delta_alpha1>=Delta_alpha2 for every alpha1<alpha2 under case3 conditions.
problems.location: PDF p20,p30 Theorem F.3(3); p32 equations117-120; core dependency main p6
problems.check: Exact Fraction witness p=(256,256,33)/545, q=(16,1,528)/545, alpha1=1/4,alpha2=1/2, c0=2,zeta=.01,delta2=.5. Softmax normalization cancels.
problems.counterevidence: Fixed-beta Theorem D.1 comparison survives; merely increasing underestimation ratio does not restore F.3(3), as proved by parameterized family in report AppendixA.
problems.impact: False supporting comparison for central alpha-beta versus alpha-divergence rationale; no empirical ranking refuted.

problems.title: Full row rank does not supply uniform inverse conditioning
problems.claim: grad_W tends to0 and full-row-rank J imply grad_f tends to0.
problems.location: PDF p17 Appendix C.2 equations12-13; core bridge in Section3.1 p3
assumptions: C-by-M logit Jacobian full row rank at every finite iterate
parameter-gradient descent and strictly positive softmax distributions
problems.check: FKLD p=(.75,.25), f=(.1*tanh w1,.1*tanh w2), W0=0. Symmetry yields t growing unbounded while J stays rank2 at finite t. Exact analytic limit gives nonzero grad_f and zero grad_W; independent100000-step illustration saved.
problems.result: Stated limiting inference false even on an actual gradient-descent trajectory.
problems.counterevidence: At fixed finite stationary point full rank suffices; independent output biases or uniform smallest singular value can restore implication. Logit update identities survive.
problems.impact: Invalid bridge from model-weight stationarity to core logit-concentration explanation; not an assertion about experimental trajectories.
problems.correction: Require inf sigma_min(J_k)>=c>0, yielding norm grad_f<=norm grad_W/c.
problems.repair_verification: analytic sufficiency proven; no experimental architecture certificate

problems.title: Vision release boundary branches omit a denominator factor
problems.claim: Released implementation should match AppendixB continuous extension.
assumptions: finite logits so infinity masking irrelevant
problems.check: Independent scalar evaluations at p=(.25,.75),q=(.5,.5), boundary parameters .5 and -1 compare paper squared denominator to release unsquared.
problems.result: Loss scaled by alpha/beta, with negative values at negative parameters.
problems.counterevidence: General branch and LLM branches match; primary ABKD Table4 parameters nonsingular; current commit not proven historical.
problems.impact: Current-release local implementation defect; core experiment dependency not demonstrated.
problems.correction: Square denominator beta,alpha,alpha in respective three branches.
problems.repair_verification: scalar algebra only; no patched author code executed

limitations: No empirical reproduction or author-code execution.
Historical experimental commit and exact selected checkpoints unresolved.
External OpenReview supplements not available in preparation record; embedded appendix available.
No comprehensive later-erratum search; no claim of first discovery.
